_spec.purpose: Monthly manager-centric risk summary delivered to Slack as .html

page_1.title: Manager × Category heat-map (30-day)
page_1.cell_value: COUNT(risk_events) in the past 30 days + delta vs prior month

page_2_plus.title: Per-manager monthly timelines
page_2_plus.content: Chronological risk_events across all manager's partners for the month
page_2_plus.extras: Partner-level subtotals per manager; trend arrows vs prior month

_spec.db_query_hint: SELECT re.*, p.name as partner_name, p.owner_manager_id, u.full_name as manager_name FROM risk_events re JOIN partners p ON p.id = re.partner_id JOIN internal_users u ON u.id = p.owner_manager_id WHERE re.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month') AND re.created_at < date_trunc('month', now()) ORDER BY u.full_name, re.created_at
_spec.on_no_activity: INSERT INTO summaries_skipped and skip posting

llm_narrative.prompt: Generate a 3-4 sentence monthly risk assessment for manager {name}. Cover: top risk categories, trend vs last month, any concerning patterns. Be factual and actionable.
